paper.title: Gaia Data Release 3: Chemical cartography of the Milky Way

methodology.question: How can present stellar traces support candidate Galactic histories without collapsing observation, derivation, classification, and interpretation?
methodology.selectionRule: Across four fixed source_id sky bands, collect 400 ascending orbital candidates per band and rule profile; then take the first 8 ascending source_id values in the paper's High sample and the first 8 in Medium-but-not-High.

qualityDefinitions.medium: Appendix B General exclusions plus Teff/logg/uncertainty limits and GSP-Spec flag positions 1-6 <=1, 7 <=3, 8 <=2, 13 <=1.
qualityDefinitions.high: Appendix B Teff/logg limits and GSP-Spec flag positions 1-7 =0, 8 <=2, 9-12 =0, 13 <=1.

evidenceLayers.role: catalogue observations and reported measurement uncertainty
stellar-parameter and chemical-abundance estimates with percentile intervals
orbit and action estimates with reported intervals
deterministic rule-profile membership, not a native Gaia label
bounded compatibility statements, not a recovered birth history

ruleProfiles.label: Cold rotating / metal-rich rule profile
ruleProfiles.rule: vphi >= 180 km/s; eccentricity <= 0.2; zmax <= 0.5 kpc; [M/H] >= -0.5 dex

ruleProfiles.label: Alpha-raised intermediate-orbit rule profile
ruleProfiles.candidatePredicate: vphi_med >= 100 AND vphi_med < 200 AND ecc_med > 0.2 AND ecc_med < 0.6 AND zmax_med > 0.5 AND zmax_med < 3
ruleProfiles.rule: 100 <= vphi < 200 km/s; 0.2 < eccentricity < 0.6; 0.5 < zmax < 3 kpc; -1 <= [M/H] < -0.3 dex; [alpha/Fe] >= 0.15 dex
interpretations: alpha-raised dynamically warm disc-like present-day pattern

ruleProfiles.label: Radial metal-poor rule profile
ruleProfiles.rule: vphi >= 0 km/s; eccentricity >= 0.7; zmax >= 3 kpc; [M/H] <= -0.8 dex
interpretations: compatible with more than one formation channel

ruleProfiles.label: Counter-rotating metal-poor rule profile
interpretations: compatible with accretion-related interpretations, but not proof of origin

qualityAblation.interpretationResult: All four rule-profile patterns remain represented; estimates shift and half of the bounded cohort is excluded.

evidenceAblation.reason: The declared profiles require chemistry and published orbit estimates.
Chemistry alone does not satisfy the declared chemo-kinematic rules.
The values support deterministic rule membership, not a formation history.
Publication context permits bounded compatibility statements while alternative histories remain possible.

statements: alpha-raised dynamically warm disc-like present-day pattern
compatible with more than one formation channel
compatible with accretion-related interpretations, but not proof of origin

reconstruction.result: Present-day chemo-kinematic patterns support inspectable candidate historical interpretations; they do not identify a unique origin for any star.

historicalLoad.reason: No finite path space, transition cost, or history-free counterfactual baseline is declared; undefined must not be displayed as zero.

nonClaims: The 64-source cohort is not a representative census of the Milky Way.
A Gaia catalogue value is not automatically a direct instrument reading.
A Gaia Apsis estimate is not promoted to an observation.
A published orbital estimate is not promoted to a direct Gaia observation.
An Onto2D rule profile is not a Gaia population label.
A rule-profile assignment is not a recovered stellar birth site.
Chemical similarity is not proof of common ancestry.
A counter-rotating or radial orbit is not proof of accretion origin.
Missing radial velocity is retained as missing and never converted to zero.
Quality-filtered sources are absent from the strict view.
Reported percentile intervals and measurement errors are not silently discarded.
The canonical artifact never depends on a live TAP response.
disclaimer: Research demonstration only. Candidate Galactic-history compatibility is not a recovered birth origin, unique formation history, or ancestry determination.
